notes: TMA03 requires defined outage durations, varied message rates, larger samples and repeated runs, but does not prescribe exact numerical values.
The 100 ms delay and 10% loss condition reuses the exploratory TMA03 impairment setting.
Each condition is repeated three times.
Outage tets use post-publisher controlled recovery. Concurrent live forwarding during recovery is not claimed in these tests.
